statements.t: We expect the resulting shipment delays to be a matter of timing rather than lost business, with affected shipments anticipated to move into 2027 as production returns to normal levels during the first quarter.
Field validation on live customer systems has performed well, FCC certification is expected by year-end, and we remain on track to achieve mass production by March 2027.

“Reflecting the anticipated deferral of BKR 9000 shipments, we are updating our full-year 2026 outlook to approximately $85 million in revenue, GAAP diluted EPS of $2.40, and non-GAAP adjusted diluted EPS of $3.15, while reaffirming our gross margin target of at least 50%.
Our updated earnings guidance excludes potential recoveries under our business interruption insurance coverage and potential refunds of previously paid tariffs.
We remain confident in our ability to restore normal operations, fulfill our customer commitments, and execute our Vision 2030 strategy.”
